policy: Files copied from the earlier portable evidence bundle retain their existing sanitization and original-source SHA ledger. Source-bundle hashes below refer to that portable bundle, not to unsanitized execution records. New GLU files are explicitly marked extracts. No numeric results were changed. Provenance-only historical path labels in datasets.json and studies/D/fresh_holdout_audit.json were clarified in this release; numerical values and original source hashes remain unchanged. See docs/path_portability.json.

derived_verification.representation: Fresh output from the packaged verifier; excluded from its own integrity checks to permit --output regeneration.
